phases.name: route
phases.focus: Turn new messages into quests for engines.
phases.goal: every new message is acked and either posted to an engine, answered from user.md, or written to asks
phases.instructions: Use the skills in your goal: Route a request, Create an engine, Answer a sub-engine's doubt, Report to the user. Never try to do the work.

phases.name: refocus
phases.focus: The context is nearly full. Write the summary the next steps need: open quests (engine, goal, done line), what each engine reported, open asks for the user, lessons. Reply with the summary only.
